in_marathi.name: Balkishan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's weapon, god's power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balkishan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Balkishan is derived from Sanskrit. It is a combination of two words, ‘Bal’ meaning strength or power and ‘Kishan’ meaning god. Thus, Balkishan means ‘God's weapon’ or ‘God's power’. It is a name that evokes a sense of divine protection and strength.
